# AI Infra Jobs (warpjobs.com)

> A curated, daily-refreshed job board for GPU, CUDA, ML-systems, inference and performance-engineering roles at AI labs and infrastructure startups. Listings are aggregated directly from each company's public ATS feed (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) and link to the original posting — the site stores no applications or personal data.

## Key pages
- [All open roles](https://warpjobs.com/): the full live board, refreshed daily.
- [Who's hiring](https://warpjobs.com/companies-hiring/): leaderboard of companies by open-role count, with the specialty, salary and visa mix for each — the "which companies are staffing up" view.
- [GPU & CUDA engineering jobs](https://warpjobs.com/gpu-jobs/)
- [Inference & model-serving jobs](https://warpjobs.com/inference-jobs/)
- [Performance & kernel engineering jobs](https://warpjobs.com/performance-engineering-jobs/)
- [ML-systems & infrastructure jobs](https://warpjobs.com/ml-systems-jobs/)
- [Remote roles](https://warpjobs.com/remote/)
- [Jobs in Europe](https://warpjobs.com/region/europe/)
- [Senior roles](https://warpjobs.com/level/senior/) · [Staff/principal roles](https://warpjobs.com/level/staff/)

## Data & source
- JSON feed: https://warpjobs.com/jobs.json
- RSS feed: https://warpjobs.com/feed.xml
- Open-source scraper and company list: https://github.com/ququyixiaozei/aijobs
